metadata.description: Echo of input metadata. Free-form JSON value.

input_tags.description: Echo of input input_tags. Must be identical to the payload input_tags (use [] when not provided).

remove_tags.description: Tags from input_tags that should be removed. Each element MUST be an exact match of a string in input_tags; no invented strings allowed. Empty array in pure-inference mode.

add_tags.description: Canonical tags to be added. Each element MUST belong to the controlled vocabulary (valid_tags) when in controlled-vocabulary mode. Must be empty in pure-inference mode. No duplicates.

suggest_tags.description: Normalized tag candidates that are NOT in valid_tags, for downstream vocabulary governance. Each item has a 'tag' conforming to the tag naming standard and a 'note' providing a concise semantic explanation. No duplicate tags. Stable-sorted by tag lexicographically.

tag.description: Normalized tag string conforming to facet:value/path naming convention (e.g. 'model:DL/DETR'). Facet always lowercase; multi-word segments use '-'; registered abbreviations are uppercase.

note.description: Concise, direct semantic explanation of the tag value (e.g. '目标检测', 'DEtection TRansformer'). Must NOT include rationale or extra commentary. Language governed by tag_note_language parameter.

provenance.description: Provenance metadata for the normalization run.

generated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp with 'Z' suffix indicating when this output was generated (e.g. '2026-02-11T12:34:56Z').

warnings.description: Array of human-readable warning strings describing uncertainty, fallback behavior, or non-blocking issues encountered during processing.

error.description: Error information when processing fails. On success this MUST be an empty object {}. On failure it SHOULD contain at least 'code' and 'message' fields. Additional properties are allowed.
